tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search or list AI news events. Pass `query` for semantic search, or omit it for the heat-ranked feed. Returns editorial summaries (safe to quote) with canonical /event/{slug} URLs.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One AI-news event by slug: full editorial summary plus its outbound coverage list (links to original outlets).

tools.name: related_stories
tools.description: Events most similar to a given event (centroid cosine KNN, max 5).

tools.name: daily_digest
tools.description: The daily editorial digest for a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the latest one: intro paragraph, stats, and the day's featured events.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Extracted entities (companies, models, people, themes) ranked by coverage count.

tools.name: llm_leaderboard
tools.description: Live LLM arena leaderboards (text/code/agent/document/vision/search). Rows carry arena score+votes, rank delta vs the previous daily snapshot, OpenRouter context length and USD-per-1M-token pricing. Agent board: score = net-improvement %, votes = sessions.

tools.name: route_intent
tools.description: Describe what knowledge you need in natural language; get back the right HeatPulse endpoint(s) and authoritative external sources, each with a "why".

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Bulk JSONL dataset manifest (events corpus, entities, leaderboard history, digests) for RAG/fine-tune pulls.
